thought: The user wants a simple application, and has given me the freedom to decide. A 'Hello, World!' web page is a classic, simple application that demonstrates basic web development. I will create a single HTML file for this purpose. The plan will involve researching HTML best practices, creating diagrams to visualize the structure, setting up the project directory, verifying paths and dependencies, planning the code implementation, writing the HTML code, and finally generating a report.
title: Simple Hello World HTML Page

steps.title: Research HTML Best Practices for Simple Page
steps.description: Research current HTML best practices for creating a simple 'Hello, World!' page. Focus on the basic HTML5 document structure (`<!DOCTYPE html>`, `<html>`, `<head>`, `<body>`) and recommended tags for minimal content.
steps.note: This will ensure the generated HTML follows modern standards and is correctly structured.

steps.title: Generate Hello World Page Conceptual Component Diagram
steps.description: Generate a conceptual component diagram illustrating the main components of a simple HTML Hello World page, including the document type, HTML root, head, body, and the 'Hello, World!' text element within the body.
steps.note: This diagram will help visualize the logical structure of the HTML page before creating files.

steps.title: Generate Project Directory Structure
steps.description:
Generate the directory structure for the 'Hello, World!' page project. Include:
- `index.html`: The main HTML file containing the 'Hello, World!' content.
- `README.md`: A basic project documentation file.
steps.note: This sets up the basic file organization for the project.

steps.title: Generate Hello World Page Component Diagram with Directory Structure Context
steps.description: Generate a component diagram illustrating the main components of the Hello World page, now reflecting their placement within the generated directory structure. Key components should include `index.html` and `README.md`, showing how they relate to the project root and implicitly how `index.html` contains the page content.
steps.note: This diagram will help visualize the physical structure of the project files.

steps.title: Verify Import and Export Paths
steps.description: Verify the correctness of file paths within the generated directory structure. Ensure that `index.html` is a self-contained file and does not require any external imports or dependencies referenced via file paths.
steps.note: This step confirms the project's simplicity and single-file nature.

steps.title: Resolve and Correct Dependencies
steps.description: Analyze the project structure to identify necessary dependencies. For this simple HTML file, the primary 'dependency' is the HTML5 standard. Confirm that no external libraries or frameworks requiring version resolution are needed. Note that a `package.json` is not applicable or required for this project.
steps.note: This step ensures that the project relies only on standard, universally compatible technologies.

steps.title: Plan Code Implementation Details for index.html
steps.description: Create a detailed plan for the `coder_master` to implement the `index.html` file. This plan should specify: - The required HTML5 doctype declaration. - The basic ``, ``, and `` structure. - The content of the `` section (e.g., ``). - The content of the `<body>` section, specifically embedding the 'Hello, World!' text within an appropriate HTML element (e.g., an `<h1>` or `<p>` tag). - Ensure the plan emphasizes creating a single, self-contained HTML file.
steps.note: This plan will serve as a comprehensive guide for the `coder_master` to write the HTML code.

steps.title: Implement Simple Hello World HTML Page
steps.description:
Write the complete code for the `index.html` file based on the project requirements and the detailed code plan. Implement:
- The HTML5 doctype.
- The basic `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>` structure.
- A `<title>` tag in the head.
- Embed the 'Hello, World!' text within a suitable tag (like `<h1>`) inside the body.
- Ensure the output is a single, well-formatted HTML file.
steps.note: This step involves writing all the application code for the 'Hello, World!' page.

steps.title: Generate Project Report
steps.description: Generate a final report summarizing the implemented 'Hello, World!' HTML page. Include a brief overview of the project, the technology used (HTML5), the core functionality (displaying 'Hello, World!'), and confirm that it is a single-file implementation as requested.
steps.note: This report provides a comprehensive overview of the completed project.
